title: JPMorgan’s Mulvihill on AI Concentration Concerns
text: Aaron Mulvihill, Global Alternative Strategist at JPMorgan Asset Management, said public and private markets are connected as investors reassess the financing risks of the AI and data-center buildout. Credit demand and originations have not slowed, he said, but lenders are becoming more selective: AI-related borrowing must offer returns that justify its cost. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
